error.invalid_code: The HomeKit code must be 8 digits.
error.wrong_code: The HomeKit code is not correct. Check the 8-digit code printed above the QR code on the FP2.
error.already_paired: This FP2 is already connected to another HomeKit controller, such as Apple Home. Remove it in the Apple Home app, restart the FP2 and try again.
error.busy: The FP2 is busy with another pairing attempt. Wait a minute and try again.
error.max_tries: The FP2 refused pairing after too many wrong codes. Restart the FP2 and try again.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing with the FP2 failed. Make sure it is powered and on the same network as Homey, then try again.
error.not_found: The FP2 cannot be found on the network. Make sure it is powered and on the same network as Homey.
error.not_paired: The FP2 no longer accepts Homey. Use Repair to enter the HomeKit code again.
error.unreachable: The FP2 does not respond. Check that it is powered and connected to Wi-Fi.
error.reconnecting: Connection to the FP2 was lost. Reconnecting…
error.zone_missing: This zone no longer exists on the FP2. Choose another zone in the Flow.
error.not_ready: The FP2 is not accepting connections right now. If you just restarted it, wait a minute, close this window and start adding the device again.
error.no_zones_yet: The zones are not known yet. Wait until the FP2 has connected, then try again.
error.too_many_zone_names: You entered __count__ names, but this FP2 has __zones__ zones. Use one line per zone.
